roles.name: WALL | solid obstacle; face Y=0
roles.assumption: Arbitrary finite extent; wall plane is source datum

roles.name: LAPTOP | vented airflow surrogate
roles.assumption: Topology from Dell manuals; internal cavity, vent dimensions, fin losses and leakage are unmeasured

roles.name: LH DELL FAN | actuator zone; NOT solid
roles.assumption: Separate internal blower; axial intake +Y then hinge discharge +Z. Pressure-flow curve and RPM unknown

roles.name: RH DELL FAN | actuator zone; NOT solid
roles.assumption: Separate internal blower; axial intake +Y then hinge discharge +Z. Pressure-flow curve and RPM unknown

roles.name: INTAKE GRILLE | porous interface; NOT solid
roles.assumption: Open area and pressure-loss law unmeasured; do not treat this marker as an impermeable wall

parameters.name: CFD_laptopEnvelopeThickness
parameters.comment: CLEARANCE ENVELOPE | Source model thickness; not measured internal chassis

parameters.name: CFD_ventBandWidth
parameters.comment: UNMEASURED | Long underside intake grille width

parameters.name: CFD_ventBandHeight
parameters.comment: UNMEASURED | Intake band height toward hinge

parameters.name: CFD_hingeExhaustWidth
parameters.comment: UNMEASURED | Hinge exhaust width per blower

parameters.name: CFD_hingeExhaustHeight
parameters.comment: UNMEASURED | Hinge opening depth normal to underside

parameters.name: CFD_wallHalfWidth
parameters.comment: CFD DOMAIN | Wall lateral extent, sensitivity test required

parameters.name: CFD_wallThickness
parameters.comment: CFD REFERENCE | Solid wall lies entirely behind Y=0

solver_status: Geometry surrogates only; Dell blower curve, grille/fin resistance, and heat load are unset
